starts without this one's messages.

p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # Stack the colored bars diagonally, preserving each color block\n    # and shifting the pattern upward/leftward as colors advance.\n    # Identify objects by color and their original bounding boxes.\n    import collections\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    pos=collections.defaultdict(list)\n    for r,row in enumerate(grid):\n        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v: pos[v].append((r,c))
    colors=sorted(pos, key=lambda v:min(pos[v]))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # Demos show vertical bars and blocks rearranged as a connected diagonal chain.
    # Their object order is read from top-to-bottom, then left-to-right.
    for i,v in enumerate(colors):
        cells=pos[v]
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
        # retain shape; anchor objects along a staircase from upper left
        nr=i*2
        nc=i
        for r,c in cells:
            rr=nr+(r-r0); cc=nc+(c-c0)
            if rr<h and cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
''')
